title: Scribble Flow - draw on a blank canvas, SDXL + ControlNet renders it
description: Dev-gated Flow. No input media: pick an aspect ratio, draw on a blank white canvas and prompt beneath it, generate. Keeps the SDXL + ControlNet render half that the Draw It In Klein rebuild deletes - both preprocessor arms, the five-model slot with LoRAs, and Input_Control_strength with its 0-1 -> 0-0.5 remap intact. One piece of new work: MpiStepPaint sizes its canvas from props.media?.url and needs a blank-canvas fallback. Design: brief.md.
